text:
Noah: Quick thread 11 Need to finalize how we list appliance+partner HW bundles in the marketplace for EU/APAC customers. Two open Qs: display/localization vs settlement currency, and renewal true-up windows. @Priya @Carlos thoughts?
Priya: Partner ops preference = show local list prices on the offer so procurement sees native currency. But they insist invoices settle in USD. They also asked for a clear partner margin field on the PO so they can reconcile.
Carlos: Finance POV: prefer single settlement currency (USD) and avoid per-country pricebooks. Proposed pattern: store canonical list_price_usd per SKU, compute display_price_{local} using daily FX rate, and include "partner_margin_pct" metadata. That avoids multiple price versions.
Grace: Sales: buyers will ask "is this price final?" if display prices vary by FX. We should lock a display-rate window for quote validity (e.g., 7 days). Also want a "quote-friendly" export so AE can include local VAT lines.
Noah: Draft marketplace metadata for private offers: sku, list_price_usd, display_currencies, quote_valid_days, settlement_currency, partner_margin_pct, commit_band_usd, true_up_window_days, renewal_incentive_pct. Example: ```sku: HW-APPL-STD
list_price_usd: 60000
display_currencies: [EUR, AUD, SGD]
quote_valid_days: 7
settlement_currency: USD
partner_margin_pct: 12
commit_band_usd: [50000,100000,250000]
true_up_window_days: 30
renewal_incentive_pct: 10```
Ivy: Ops note 1 Ops can surface display_price but marketplace settlement remains USD. For true-ups: we can implement a 30-day post-term reconciliation where usage above commit triggers an invoice, below commit triggers a partner credit (if partner bears shortfall). Need to map who receives credits: partner or customer?
Priya: Partner insists credits accrue to their partner account (they subsidize rebates). They want monthly snapshots and a 30-day dispute window.
LegalBot: Legal flagged two items: (1) warranty/faults for third-party HW must be disclaimed in the PO and routed to partner SLA, (2) FX clause: we need language that display prices are estimates; final settlement in USD and tax/VAT are additional. I'll draft minimal T&C.
Carlos: On renewals, recommend dual-track: (A) automatic renewal with opt-out + renewal discount schedule, or (B) active re-bid which triggers a new private-offer. For committed customers we usually push early renewal (60 days) and offer trade-in credits for legacy appliances. We should encode renewal_flow metadata: auto_renew=true/false, early_renew_discount_pct.
Grace: For partner enablement, we need a templated quote PDF that shows: local display price, USD settlement line, partner_margin, VAT estimate, and a "quote expiration" timestamp. Sales ops can generate via /marketplace/quote-export API.
Noah: Tech ask: can marketplace handle partner_margin_pct visible only to partner and not end-customer? We can't leak margins on public pages.
Ivy: Yes, metadata supports partner-only visibility flags. We'll add partner_visibility: [partner_margin_pct, partner_contact_email].
Priya: Tax question: if we issue partner credits (partner bears shortfall), VAT treatment differs. Partners must confirm with their tax counsel. I'll collect partner's VAT ID and confirm.
Noah: PricingBot, run quick sim: display vs settlement variance impact on ARR and churn risk for a 12-month commit with 30-day true-up and 7-day quote validity.
PricingBot: Sim results uploaded -> /pricing/sim-2460001111.csv. Key: projected ARR +14% with display_currency + 7-day quote; churn delta -2% if trade-in credit included. Assumptions: FX volatility capped at 5% per quarter.
Grace: Next steps: Priya to get partner VAT info + accept draft PO metadata, Legal to drop T&C snippet, Ops (Ivy) to confirm partner-only visibility flags + implement quote-export template, Carlos to own finance settlement flows and true-up invoice template. I'll collect action owners and ship a draft to partner inbox by EOD Fri.
Noah: Thanks all. Sync tomorrow 9am PT if needed.
Priya: :thumbsup: will update partner and confirm timeline.
Noah: Filing notes: https://docs.google.com/example-hw-offer (internal).
